20:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Basketball
The North Carolina Tar Heels (5-1) play the West Virginia Mountaineers (4-2) at Spectrum Center. West Virginia seeks to snap a two-game skid after an 85-72 loss to Florida, while North Carolina aims to make it three straight victories.
